jobs.title: German Speaking Customer Success Account Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Location:
Leipzig or Würzburg (Hybrid — up to 1 Home Office day/week)

Department:
Customer Success Management

Employment Type:
Full-Time / Multi-Year Experience

Language Requirements:
Fluent German (C1) & Fluent English (C1)

Compensation:
€40,000 – €50,000 gross p.a. base + Annual Bonus

About The Employer & Mission

We are a fast-growing, agile software enterprise (101–500 employees) developing products and services dedicated to digital accessibility and inclusion. As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will play a high-impact, key strategic role, directly influencing company growth while partnering with high-profile corporate accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Ownership: Independently own, manage, and strategically grow relationships with enterprise customer accounts.
Relationship Building: Establish long-term, trust-based partnerships with key corporate decision-makers and executive stakeholders.
Value Expansion: Proactively identify and execute up-sell and cross-sell opportunities in close alignment with internal Enterprise Sales and Product Management teams.
Lifecycle Governance: Manage the end-to-end customer journey, including onboarding, product adoption, optimization, and contract renewals.
Data-Driven Success: Conduct regular Business Reviews, tracking key performance metrics and delivering clear evidence of ROI and impact.
Churn Mitigation: Detect early warning signals and churn risks, developing proactive retention and risk-mitigation strategies.
Cross-Functional Interface: Serve as the primary advocate and communication hub between enterprise clients and internal technical, product, and sales units.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Must-Haves:
Relevant Track Record: Multi-year experience as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager managing enterprise-level accounts within a fast-paced Start-Up or Scale-Up environment.
Bilingual Capability: Fluent professional communication skills in both German (C1) and English (C1) (spoken and written).
Tool Expertise: Practical, hands-on experience using modern CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot).
Core Competencies: Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, paired with client-centric orientation and negotiation acumen.

Nice-to-Haves:
Proficiency in additional languages.

Personality Traits:
Challenging Mindset: Willingness to challenge client assumptions and provide expert guidance.
Ambitious & Assertive: Highly driven, proactive, and comfortable taking initiative in complex client environments.
Team-Oriented: Collaborative attitude with enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork.

Compensation & Core Benefits

Attractive Package: €40,000 – €50,000 gross annual base salary, plus an annual performance bonus and 30 days of paid vacation.
Strategic Autonomy: A pivotal role with high visibility, clear impact, and continuous professional growth opportunities within Customer Success.
Work-Life Integration: Flexible working hours combined with a hybrid work model (up to 1 home-office day per week).
Planning Security: 0% travel requirement, ensuring consistent work-life stability and predictable scheduling.
Meaningful Vision: Direct involvement in delivering software solutions that improve accessibility and digital equality worldwide.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Sales and Business Development

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet

Company & Role Summary

We are a fast-growing tech scale-up developing innovative software solutions for web accessibility. As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will play a central role in driving business growth by nurturing strategic enterprise client relationships, driving platform adoption, and ensuring long-term retention.

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Relationship Management: Direct key corporate accounts and cultivate long-term partnerships with C-level stakeholders.
Account Expansion: Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities in close alignment with Sales and Product teams.
Lifecycle Success: Lead seamless client onboarding, continuous feature adoption, and recurring contract renewals.
Value Reviews: Conduct data-backed business reviews to highlight measurable ROI for client partners.
Churn Prevention: Monitor account health signals to proactively identify risks and execute retention strategies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic bridge connecting enterprise clients with internal product, technical, and sales teams.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: Proven background in Account Management or Enterprise Customer Success within a B2B SaaS, start-up, or scale-up environment.
Languages: Fluent C1-level proficiency in both German and English (spoken and written).
Tools: Hands-on experience with modern CRM environments (HubSpot preferred).
Mindset: Strong strategic thinking, negotiation capabilities, and a self-driven work ethic.
Bonus: Additional European language skills are a plus.

Offerings & Benefits

Compensation: €40,000 – €50,000 annual base salary plus performance bonus and 30 days of paid annual leave.
Impact: High-visibility position with strong autonomy and clear paths for personal and career advancement.
Flexibility: Regular office hours, 1 work-from-home day per week, and no business travel requirements.
Mission: Work with a purpose-driven team dedicated to making the digital world accessible to everyone.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Customer Success Specialist helps customers adopt the product and realize value through onboarding, education, issue resolution, customer communication, risk escalation, and cross-functional feedback sharing.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Guide new customers through onboarding and product setup
• Respond to customer questions with clear, timely, and helpful communication
• Educate customers on product features, workflows, and best practices
• Track customer goals, adoption signals, issues, and follow-up actions
• Identify risks and escalate technical or account concerns to the right teams
• Capture customer feedback and partner with product, support, and sales teams
Qualification

Required

• Strong written and verbal communication with a customer-first mindset
• Excellent organization, follow-through, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to explain product concepts clearly to different audiences
• Comfort learning software tools and managing multiple customer conversations
• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Internship, part-time, volunteer, or project experience in customer success, support, account management, or hospitality
• Familiarity with CRM, help-desk, project management, or collaboration tools
• Experience supporting a SaaS, technology, education, or recruiting product
• Basic ability to analyze customer usage data and identify trends

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Entry level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Sales

Industries

Software Development

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst, Entry Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is a personal AI job search agent that simplifies the job search process and helps users reach better job outcomes. The Compliance Analyst supports policy adherence and regulatory compliance through research, control and process reviews, monitoring, audit support, remediation tracking, documentation, and stakeholder reporting.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Review processes and records for alignment with policies and requirements
• Research regulatory and industry requirements and summarize their impact
• Collect evidence, maintain compliance trackers, and document review results
• Support monitoring activities, audits, and issue remediation
• Prepare clear reports, metrics, and status updates for stakeholders
• Coordinate with legal, security, operations, and product teams on compliance tasks
Qualification

Required

• Strong attention to detail, research ability, and written communication
• Ability to interpret policies and apply requirements consistently
• Comfort working with spreadsheets, documentation, and structured review workflows
• Sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information
• Ability to organize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a remote environment

Preferred

• Coursework, internship, certification, or project experience in compliance, audit, legal, privacy, or security
• Exposure to privacy, consumer protection, employment, financial, or technology compliance
• Familiarity with GRC, ticketing, case management, or document management tools
• Experience supporting an audit, policy review, or control assessment
